title: 🚨 THE CHURCH DOESN’T NEED MORE PEOPLE WITH TITLES.
paragraphs:
🚨 THE CHURCH DOESN’T NEED MORE PEOPLE WITH TITLES.
IT NEEDS MORE LEADERS WHO LOOK LIKE JESUS.
A microphone doesn’t make you a shepherd.
A position doesn’t make you mature.
And being gifted does not automatically mean you’re ready to lead God’s people.
That truth may be uncomfortable.
But the Church is too precious to Jesus for us to build leadership on charisma alone.

📖 HOW TO TRAIN CHURCH LEADERS FOR JESUS
Raising Servants Who Follow Christ, Guard the Gospel, and Equip Others
This book was created for pastors, ministry leaders, mentors, emerging leaders, and believers who want to raise disciples—not personalities.
Because Jesus never commanded us to manufacture celebrities.
He commanded us to make disciples.

“And what you have heard from me in the presence of many witnesses entrust to faithful men, who will be able to teach others also.”
— 2 Timothy 2:2
🔥 WHY THIS BOOK MATTERS
Churches can teach people how to preach…
but fail to teach them how to repent.
We can train people to organize ministries…
but neglect their prayer lives.
We can recognize talent…
while overlooking character.
We can build platforms…
without building disciples.
That has to change.
Inside How to Train Church Leaders for Jesus, you’ll discover:

• How to identify potential leaders by faithfulness and character—not talent alone
• Why character must come before platform
• How to train leaders to understand and communicate the Gospel
• How to develop leaders who handle Scripture faithfully
• How prayer, service, mentoring, and accountability shape strong leaders
• How to correct emerging leaders without crushing them
• How to guard leadership from pride and celebrity culture
• How to develop shepherds who actually care for people
• A practical 12-week church leadership training framework
• How to build leaders who eventually train other leaders
This isn't about creating followers of a pastor.
It’s about raising followers of JESUS who can help others follow Jesus.
⚔️ MOST PEOPLE VS. THE FEW

Most people want the title.
Few want the towel.

Most want the microphone.
Few embrace hidden service.

Most celebrate gifting.
Few patiently develop character.

Most want followers.
Few make disciples who make disciples.
Most want God to enlarge their influence.
Few ask God to deepen their obedience first.
So ask yourself:
What kind of leader are you becoming?
🎁 And more
It's about building a movement of believers who take discipleship seriously.
⚔️ THE GOSPEL WARRIOR CALL
If you believe the Church needs leaders with character before charisma…
If you believe leaders should serve instead of seeking status…
If you believe the next generation needs shepherds, not celebrities…
If you want to help put Christ-centered teaching into more hands…
Then don't keep this message to yourself:

WE DON'T NEED TO BUILD OUR NAMES.
WE NEED TO BUILD DISCIPLES.
Jesus is Lord.
The Church belongs to Jesus.
The mission belongs to Jesus.
And the glory belongs to Jesus.

⚔️ GOSPEL WARRIOR
Faith. Truth. Victory.
